name: spend-statusline
description: Claude Code status line showing session, day, week, and month spend, daily average, and a monthly budget projection.

show_session.title: Show session
show_session.description: Show the session segment in the status line.

show_today.title: Show today
show_today.description: Show the today segment in the status line.

show_week.title: Show week
show_week.description: Show the week segment in the status line.

show_month.title: Show month
show_month.description: Show the month segment in the status line.

show_avg.title: Show daily average
show_avg.description: Show the daily average segment in the status line.

show_proj.title: Show projection
show_proj.description: Show the projection segment in the status line.

breakdown.title: Cost breakdown table
breakdown.description: Print a table below the status line with spend by token type (input, output, cache read, cache write) for the periods selected below.

breakdown_split.title: Breakdown: split
breakdown_split.description: combined: one row per period. main/agents: separate rows for the main loop and subagents.

breakdown_session.title: Breakdown: session
breakdown_session.description: Include session in the breakdown table.

breakdown_today.title: Breakdown: today
breakdown_today.description: Include today in the breakdown table.

breakdown_week.title: Breakdown: week
breakdown_week.description: Include week in the breakdown table.

breakdown_month.title: Breakdown: month
breakdown_month.description: Include month in the breakdown table.

pr_integration.title: PR integration
pr_integration.description: Show the session's pull requests in the status line when it has any.

pr_max.title: PRs shown (max)
pr_max.description: Maximum PRs shown in the status line, most recently seen first; [...] is appended when more remain.

pr_show_obsolete.title: Show merged and closed PRs
pr_show_obsolete.description: Show merged and closed PRs dimmed; they then count toward the PR maximum. When off they are hidden and not counted.

pr_show_age.title: Show PR age
pr_show_age.description: Append the time since each PR's last update (m/h/d/w, dimmed) to its number, e.g. #3887·3d.

monthly_budget.title: Monthly budget (USD)
monthly_budget.description: Monthly budget used for the projection and budget status. CLAUDE_MONTHLY_BUDGET overrides it.
